notes.text: 3 opening(s) cut through the courses they span. 7 row(s) laid in one layer. A single layer is held only where something is built on it — pass layers: 2 for a rigid slab. Floor laid under the walls: 14 plates in 1 layer(s). Corners interlock: the X walls and the Z walls alternate which runs full length each course.
